# #529 — Operator-invoked provider capture fails scope proof while hook capture works

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-04T00:33:46Z
Updated: 2026-08-04T23:27:28Z

---

## Symptom (live, 2026-08-03)

A well-formed `capture` request through the direct provider CLI (`openbrain-memory`, JSON on stdin, `distilled=true`, full scope object, env from `claudex-observation.env`) fails at the final gate:

```
{"receipt":{...,"direct_attempted":true,"durable":false,
 "error":"session_start result did not prove exact Open Brain scope: agent, channel_id, source",
 "operation":"capture","status":"lost"}}
```

Meanwhile the hook capture path (Stop/SessionStart entrypoints) writes fine with the same env. The operator path also demanded several undocumented shapes before reaching this point (scope must be object; namespace comes only from env `OPENBRAIN_NAMESPACE`, a top-level `namespace` key is silently ignored as an "optional request key"; `distilled=true` required) — each discovered by trial.

## Why it matters

The AGENTS.md contract tells Claude to capture distilled in-flight events through exactly this provider. A capture path that fails scope-proof means in-flight process learnings get lost (status `lost` is honest, but the write still didn't happen) and agents fall back to nothing. Hit live while trying to record a workflow-staging lesson; the lesson had to live in an issue comment instead.

## Wanted

- Either the provider's session_start handshake proves the scope fields the capture gate demands (`agent`, `channel_id`, `source`), or the gate's demanded set matches what session_start actually proves.
- The silently-ignored top-level `namespace` key should be a named rejection, not `ignored_optional_request_keys` (same silent-drop family as #464/#431).
- One documented, working operator recipe in `docs/memory-contract.md` or the provider README, verified by a live canary.
